Approach to Teaching
At Connaught Special School, we use the PSHE Education Planning Framework for Pupils with SEND as a guideline for our PSHE/RSHE curriculum planning. Lessons are personalised for all learners, taught in a way that is appropriate and meaningful for their development.
Opportunities are presented for pupils (where appropriate/possible) to:
Experience taking and sharing responsibility.
Feel positive about themselves and others.
Reflect on their perceptions and experiences.
Recognise and celebrate their achievements and successes.
